resources.string: Android blocks the accessibility toggle for apps installed from a downloaded APK file. This is an OS security policy, not a Minis bug — nothing is wrong with your install. Allowing restricted settings only re-enables the toggle; it grants nothing on its own, and you still choose whether to turn the service on.
App info → ⋮ menu (top right) → Allow restricted settings
One tap — clears the flag without leaving Minis
Failed — use the manual steps below
